Another reference to Devindra can be found in the Puranic literature. In the Bhagavata Purana, there is a mention of a sage named Devindra who was a devotee of Lord Vishnu. He performed severe penances and was blessed with a vision of the deity. This Devindra is considered a manifestation of Lord Vishnu himself.
